description: This file defines the GroupPosBased class within the FastRoute DataGenerator namespace, responsible for processing route regexes and generating route mapping data structures based on positional grouping.

classes.name: GroupPosBased
classes.description: A class that extends RegexBasedAbstract to generate route data using position-based grouping for regex matching.

methods.name: getApproxChunkSize
methods.description: Returns an approximate size for chunks when processing route regexes, here fixed at 10.

methods.name: processChunk
methods.description: Processes a chunk of regex to route mappings, constructing a combined regex and a route map with handlers and variables.
